label: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
output:
**Tracked Dumper – Buy One Instead of Hiring**

Lee, I've done the sums on this so it's in writing rather than me going on at you in the van.

**What we're paying now**
I've hired the tracked dumper 14 days this year from the hire place in Sittingbourne. £85 a day plus £30 delivery each time, so roughly £1,600 all in.

**What buying one costs**
The bloke in Faversham is selling a 2019 500kg tracked dumper at £1,650 ono. Says new tracks fitted last spring. Halves is £825 each, and that's it – it's ours, sitting there when we need it, not booked three weeks out.

**How we'd split the running costs**
Fuel and oil 50/50. Servicing 50/50 as well, and whoever breaks it pays for that one. I'll keep it in the lean-to at the yard, it's covered, so there's nothing to pay for storage. And if it doesn't work out for us we can sell it on – they hold their value, so we're not stuck with it.

**Why it works for us**
Three patio digs and the Boughton drive are already booked in for spring, so it'll be earning straight away. It's not just the hire money either. Back in September the hire place hadn't got one, so we had to have 6 ton of muck borrowed in at the Hernhill job. Two extra days on that job and your back was gone for a week. The delivery driver turned up at 11 o'clock once as well and we lost half the morning.

**The sums**
At this year's use it pays for itself in about a year. At half that use, about two years. And that's before servicing and repairs, so it's quicker than that really.

**Saturday**
Can you come and look at it with me? I'd rather you saw it in the flesh before you put your hand to anything. There's been other interest in it, so let's not hang about – 10am and we go to Faversham. Bring your overalls, we're taking it for a spin if he's happy.

Have a think on it and we can go through it properly on the day.

reasons: Facts: it says the 6 ton of muck was 'borrowed in', but the request says it was barrowed by hand, and it says payback is 'quicker than that really' when the figures are before servicing and repairs, so those costs would make payback slower.
